images.title: Mouths open wider
images.purpose: Show that angles can be ordered by how wide the opening is.
images.composition: Three angles in a row with equal arm length, widths clearly increasing, wide gaps between them.
images.exact_structure: Three angles in a row, each with two equal-length arms from its own vertex: first about 20 degrees opening, second about 50 degrees, third about 90 degrees. Arcs teal #0072B2 for the smallest, amber #E69F00 for the middle, reddish purple #CC79A7 for the largest. Exactly 3 angles, all 6 arms equal length.

images.takeaway: A wider opening means a larger angle.
images.description: Three angles with equal arms in a row, opening wider from left to right, labelled smallest, middle and largest.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the smallest and the largest angle.
